cases.purpose: User-defined (extended) capabilities compiled with tic -x are readable: a string, a number, a parameterised string and a boolean, and a missing extended name fails.
cases.script:
export TERMINFO=$PWD/ti
tput -T fx215 Xfx > ext-str; echo "str=$?" > rc
tput -T fx215 Xnum > ext-num; echo "num=$?" >> rc
tput -T fx215 Xcup 9 > ext-par; echo "par=$?" >> rc
tput -T fx215 Xbool > ext-bool; echo "bool=$?" >> rc
tput -T fx215 Xabsent > ext-absent 2>/dev/null; echo "absent=$?" >> rc

files.fx.src:
fx215|fixture-alias|worker fixture terminal,
	am, cols#123, lines#45, Xbool,
	bold=BOLD215, clear=CLR215, cup=CUP%p1%d;%p2%dX, sgr0=SGR0215,
	Xfx=XFX215, Xnum#77, Xcup=XC%p1%d,
fxpad|fixture with mandatory padding,
	cols#80, lines#24, clear=CLR$<10/>,

cases.oracle: ncurses-bin 6.5 tput(1) and tic(1) on the reference PATH (compiled with tic -x in trusted setup); raw PTY bytes and file bytes compared. Extended string Xfx=XFX215, numeric Xnum#77 printed with a newline, parameterised Xcup 9 -> XC9, boolean Xbool exits 0 with no output; an undefined name exits 4 (ncurses tput exit-status contract for an unknown capability).
cases.comparison: Exact file contents and exit codes; the reference ncurses tput must reproduce them, the candidate is compared with the reference.

cases.purpose: Mandatory padding $<10/> at an output speed of 38400 baud: the pad bytes between CLR and P-DONE are NULs sized for that speed.
cases.script:
export TERMINFO=$PWD/ti
s=$(/usr/bin/stty -g)
/usr/bin/stty 38400
tput -T fxpad clear; printf 'P-DONE\n'
/usr/bin/stty "$s"

cases.purpose: tput reset restores the default special characters (intr ^C, quit ^\, erase DEL, kill ^U, eof ^D, susp ^Z) when they were disabled (undef); characters that were still defined are left as they are.
cases.script:
s=$(/usr/bin/stty -g)
/usr/bin/stty intr undef quit undef erase undef kill undef eof undef susp undef
/usr/bin/python3 cc.py > cc-before
tput reset; echo "rc=$?" > rc
/usr/bin/python3 cc.py > cc-after
printf 'X-DONE\n'
/usr/bin/stty "$s"

files.cc.py:
import termios
a = termios.tcgetattr(0)
c = a[6]
names = ['VINTR','VQUIT','VERASE','VKILL','VEOF','VSUSP','VSTART','VSTOP','VWERASE','VREPRINT','VLNEXT','VDISCARD']
print(' '.join('%s=%d' % (n, c[getattr(termios, n)][0] if isinstance(c[getattr(termios, n)], bytes) else c[getattr(termios, n)]) for n in names))

expected_files.cc-before: VINTR=0 VQUIT=0 VERASE=0 VKILL=0 VEOF=0 VSUSP=0 VSTART=17 VSTOP=19 VWERASE=23 VREPRINT=18 VLNEXT=22 VDISCARD=15
expected_files.cc-after: VINTR=3 VQUIT=28 VERASE=127 VKILL=21 VEOF=4 VSUSP=26 VSTART=17 VSTOP=19 VWERASE=23 VREPRINT=18 VLNEXT=22 VDISCARD=15
